reviews.body:
Verified by reading the code against the sibling adapters. `endpoint` flows from the constructor into `GenericAPIAdapter` as `self.endpoint`, and the openai/gemini/generic adapters already pass `api_base=self.endpoint` on this same path, so Mistral was the outlier that never forwarded `LLM_ENDPOINT` to LiteLLM. The `setdefault` precedence is right: an explicit `api_base` in `llm_args` or `kwargs` wins, and a blank endpoint is skipped so LiteLLM keeps its default Mistral URL. The three parametrized cases in the new test match the code exactly.

Two edge cases worth a look:

- A whitespace-only endpoint (`" "`) is truthy, so it would be sent as `api_base`. Stripping (or treating blank as unset) would close that gap.
- If `kwargs` carries `api_base=None` explicitly, `setdefault` leaves the `None` in place rather than falling back to the endpoint.

I could not run the new test locally: this environment has no cognee dependencies installed (`structlog`, `instructor`), so please let CI confirm the parametrized cases. Non-binding review (COMMENT only, no approval).
